scenes.name: Classroom Bell & Morning Whistle
scenes.subtitle: Last bench window breeze • Doodling on the back page

scenes.name: Rough Copy & Forgotten Formulas
scenes.subtitle: Algebra forgotten • Only her smile in the margins

lines.text: Rough copy ke aakhri panne pe, tera hi naam likha maine,
Formula saare bhula ke bhi, bas tujhko yaad rakha maine.

scenes.name: Classroom Noise & Cycle Rush
scenes.subtitle: Unspoken heartbeats • Racing cycles when the bell rings

lines.text: Class mein dhyan lagata hoon, par nazrein tujh pe rehti hain,
Dhadkanein meri bina kahe, kitna kuch tujhse kehti hain!
Haan chhutti ki ghanti bajte hi, dil cycle tez chalata hai,
Rough copy ke aakhri panne pe, tera hi naam likha maine.

scenes.name: Interlude 1 - Corridor Reverie
scenes.subtitle: Chalk dust floating in afternoon sunbeams • Acoustic warmth

scenes.name: Recess Collision & Borrowed Blue Pen
scenes.subtitle: A hurried sorry • A pen never returned • Attendance roll call

lines.text: Woh recess ki thodi jaldi mein, corridor mein takraana tera,
Sorry keh kar halke se, nazrein jhuka ke muskuraana tera.
Ik blue ink pen jo maangi thi, maine aaj talak lautayi nahi,
Us din se dosti dhoondhi thi, par aage baat badhayi nahi.

scenes.name: Roll Call Attendance & Front Bench Sunshine
scenes.subtitle: Her voice answering the register • Golden afternoon light

lines.text: Jab roll call pe tu Present kahe, mera dil be-wajah hi jhoome hai,
Tu aage ki bench pe baithi rahe, aur dhoop tere rukh choome hai.

scenes.name: Mukhda Reprise & Nostalgia Chorus
scenes.subtitle: Rough copy notes • The unforgettable classroom anthem

lines.text: Rough copy ke aakhri panne pe, tera hi naam likha maine,
Formula saare bhula ke bhi, bas tujhko yaad rakha maine.
Haan chhutti ki ghanti bajte hi, dil cycle tez chalata hai,
Rough copy ke aakhri panne pe, tera hi naam likha maine.

scenes.name: Interlude 2 - Cycle Stand Sunset
scenes.subtitle: Waiting by the pedals • Shadows lengthening across the playground

scenes.name: Cycle Stand & Mirror Rehearsal
scenes.subtitle: Watching her bus depart • Rehearsing 'Hi' in the bedroom mirror

lines.text: Cycle stand pe rukta hoon, jab tak tu bag uthati nahi,
Teri bus jab tak mud na jaaye, chain se shaam aati nahi.
Ghar aake kitaabein kholta hoon, homework toh bas bahaana hai,
History ke soye panno mein, bas tera zikr sajaana hai.
Doston ne chheda kitni dafa, main jhoothi kasmein khata hoon,
Par aaine ke aage khade, tujhe Hi kehne sharmata hoon!

scenes.name: Bridge - Courage Beyond The Last Bench
scenes.subtitle: One day I'll step forward • Just one glance is enough

lines.text: Kabhi toh aakhri bench se aage, main himmat karke aaunga,
Tujhe rough copy ka har panna, chupke se dikhlaunga.
Yeh darr bhi hai ke tu hans na de, par umeed bhi thodi baaqi hai,
Tera mud ke ek dafa dekhna, bas itna hi kaafi hai...
Haan itna hi kaafi hai!

scenes.name: Outro - Final Period Bell & Notebook Close
scenes.subtitle: Rough copy gently closed in bag • A sweet innocent memory preserved

lines.text: Rough copy ke aakhri panne pe... tera hi naam likha maine...
Bas maths ke aakhri period mein, tujhko hi yaad rakha maine...
